problem: FI and Cf are each modeled as a single ship-level value, but the requirement defines both along the hull girder as functions of longitudinal position. Multiple calculation cases therefore share one FI and one Cf, making cases in the 0–0.6 LUI and 0.9–1.0 LUI regions require the same Cf to be both 0.0 and 1.0.
required_change: Associate FI and Cf with each longitudinal calculation case and enforce FI = Cf × FIB, including the MN-to-kN conversion, independently for every positive-shear case. Resolve locked canonical case-owned terms or paths because the supplied FI and Cf terms are designated ship-owned.
regression_guard: Preserve the ship target, positive-shear applicability, positional boundaries, and MN-to-kN conversion while making FI and Cf case-specific.

location: gs:I2_051_ShipShape hasCalculationCase constraint and SPARQL WHERE clause
problem: Only one linked case must satisfy gs:I2_051_CalculationCaseShape. Additional cases asserted as positive shear may omit a numeric position, have an invalid position quantity or unit, or otherwise fail that shape; the SPARQL joins then skip missing values and the ship can still conform.
required_change: Conditionally require every linked positive-shear calculation case to have exactly one valid metre-valued longitudinal position and to satisfy all operands needed for its calculation, rather than requiring merely one qualified case.
regression_guard: Continue allowing calculation cases outside positive-shear applicability, but do not allow any asserted positive-shear case to bypass required position and calculation validation.
